title: Please Wait a Moment, Mr. Florist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Upbeat high-school student Sho Kamikura has a run of bad luck and an accident, and the kind florist Tokio Handa helps him up. The florist turns out to be after Sho's body and keeps making 'gropey' advances, but Sho's feelings change after he sees the florist in a weakened state (Renta! blurb). One volume; MangaUpdates also tags a later university period.
life_message: Attraction that starts as pursuit can turn into care once you see the other person's weakness.
